meta.name: agile-product-owner
meta.description: Agile product ownership for backlog management and sprint execution. Covers user story writing, acceptance criteria, sprint planning, and velocity tracking. Use when writing user stories, creating acceptance criteria, planning sprints, estimating story points, breaking down epics, or prioritizing the backlog.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 管理产品待办列表并规划冲刺执行
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你是产品负责人，需要管理待办事项和冲刺。
copy.tagline_en: Manage product backlog and plan sprint execution
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are a product owner managing backlog and sprints.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会按照敏捷产品负责人的角色，帮你编写用户故事、验收条件，规划冲刺，估算故事点，拆分史诗，并排定待办事项优先级。
howto.when: 当你要求编写用户故事、创建验收条件、规划冲刺、估算故事点、拆分史诗或排定待办事项优先级时触发。

say.text: 帮我写一个用户故事：作为市场经理，我想导出PDF报告。
say.note: Claude 会生成符合INVEST标准的用户故事。

say.text: 为这个用户故事写验收条件：用户登录后点击导出按钮。
规划一个冲刺，团队平均速度30点，可用性90%。
say.note: Claude 会计算容量并推荐承诺和延伸目标。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will act as an agile product owner to help you write user stories, acceptance criteria, plan sprints, estimate story points, break down epics, and prioritize the backlog.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to write user stories, create acceptance criteria, plan sprints, estimate story points, break down epics, or prioritize the backlog.

say_en.text: Write a user story: As a marketing manager, I want to export PDF reports.
say_en.note: Claude will generate an INVEST-compliant user story.

say_en.text: Write acceptance criteria for this user story: user clicks export after login.
Plan a sprint with average velocity 30 and availability 90%.
say_en.note: Claude will calculate capacity and suggest committed and stretch goals.
